subject: Comcast Riverside Avenue Utility Relocation
overview: The Council reviewed a petition to relocate Comcast utility infrastructure from 65 Riverside Avenue to the public right-of-way to prevent service loss for local businesses during the building's demolition. The body coordinated with city departments to ensure the developer and utility company maintain service continuity through a transition plan.

items.title: Comcast Grant of Location Petition
items.summary: Referred to the next regular meeting a petition to install approximately 273 feet of underground conduit on Riverside Avenue to prevent service disruptions for 23 commercial customers during the demolition of 65 Riverside Avenue.
